ai_summary: Here is a 2-3 sentence executive summary of the document:  Entero Healthcare Solutions Limited's subsidiary, ACE Cardiopathy Solutions, has been levied a monetary penalty of Rs. 12,91,728 by the GST Authority for non-generation of an E-Invoice. The penalty was paid under protest to secure vehicle release and avoid further operational losses; while the company deems the amount not material to its consolidated financials, it signifies a compliance lapse which the subsidiary plans to challenge for recovery.
